title: Most-watched esports team of July 2026: T1 takes top spot after appearing in four events
summary: Most-watched esports team of July 2026: T1 takes top spot after appearing in four events  Esports Charts
content:
LIVE Viewership Updates & Audience Trends

During a monthwhen fans got to witness two global championships,League of Legendsteams dominated the rankings of the most-watched teamsin July 2026.T1ended up taking the top spot, playing more matches than any other side in the top ten while accumulating 31.03 million Hours Watched.

T1 outperformed the next-best side by 31.2%, although a fewMobile Legends: Bang Bangsides attracted higher peak and average live viewers last month.

T1 played as many as four different tournaments last month, kicking July 2026 off by continuing itsMid-Season Invitational 2026journey. The three-time reigning world champion beatTeam Liquid3:0 in the final Play-In Stage match to ensure it qualified for the Bracket Stage.

This was the first of its 17 games last month, but things didn't quite work out in terms of tangible rewards. T1 played a further three matches at MSI 2026, including a thrilling series againstBilibili Gamingthat ended 2:3 in favor of the Chinese side, contributing almost 25% to the team's July HW total.

A shock loss toG2 Esportsin the Lower Bracket Round 2 saw T1 exit early in the Bracket Stage, although this game reached 2.3 million Peak Viewers, the most popular series at the mid-season championship. T1's early eliminationdid impact MSI 2026's viewership, as theLoL competitionrecorded a noticeable year-over-year decline compared with the record-setting 2025 edition.
